groupColors.description: Tag color per group name, e.g. { "Current Beşiktaş": "#000000" }; other groups get a palette color

nextMatchTeams.description: Team names (as the API spells them, e.g. "Besiktas") whose next match is shown on the dashboard; 2 requests per team per daily run

id.description: Highlightly player id; filled in automatically on first run

position.description: Main position, e.g. "Centre-Forward"; looked up from the player profile when missing ("" = profile has none)

groups.description: Dashboard groups this player belongs to, e.g. ["Former Beşiktaş"]
